units.source_text: 日色既暮，薰君趁天光薄暗之时派一匹马去迎接匂亲王来到山庄。

en.t: After the sun had already set, Lord Kaoru took advantage of the dim evening light and sent a horse to bring Prince Niou to the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 召唤弁君来前，对她说道：“我还有一句话想对大小姐说。

en.t: He summoned Ben no Kimi before him and said to her, "There is still one thing I wish to say to the elder young lady.

units.source_text: 我明知道她已经嫌恶我了，再来求见，实在很难为情。

en.t: I know perfectly well that she has come to dislike me, and it is truly embarrassing to ask to see her again.

units.source_text: 然而就此隐忍不说，又不可能。

en.t: And yet I cannot simply suppress this and say nothing.

units.source_text: 务望你替我传达。

en.t: Please, I beg you, convey it for me.

units.source_text: 再者，到了夜色稍深之时，请你再同那天一样，引导我到二小姐房中去。”

en.t: Also, when the night has grown a little deeper, please guide me to the younger young lady's room, just as you did that day."

units.source_text: 对她说得十分恳切。

en.t: He spoke to her with great earnestness.

units.source_text: 弁君认为不论大小姐或二小姐，能够拉拢，一样是好的，便进去向大女公子传达。

en.t: Ben no Kimi thought that whether it was the elder sister or the younger, it would be equally good if he could win one of them over, so she went inside and conveyed his message to Oigimi.

units.source_text: 大女公子想道：“果然不出所料，他已移向妹妹了。”

en.t: Oigimi thought, "Just as I expected, his feelings have already shifted toward my younger sister."

units.source_text: 她很高兴，心也安定了。

en.t: She was very pleased, and her heart grew calm as well.

units.source_text: 便在那天晚上薰君进来的门相反方向的厢屋里，把纸门紧紧关闭，就在那里和薰君会晤。

en.t: So, in the side room opposite the door through which Lord Kaoru had entered that night, she shut the paper doors tightly and met him there.

units.source_text: 薰君开言道：“我要说的，真不过一句话。

en.t: Lord Kaoru began, "What I wish to say is truly only a single word.

units.source_text: 大声叫喊，别人听见不好意思，请把这门略开一些吧。

en.t: If I call out loudly, it would be awkward for others to hear, so please open this door just a little.

units.source_text: 好气闷啊！”

en.t: It feels so stifling in here!"

units.source_text: 大女公子答道：“这样谈话，也很听得清楚。”

en.t: Oigimi answered, "We can speak like this and still hear each other perfectly well."

units.source_text: 不肯开门。

en.t: She refused to open the door.

units.source_text: 但继而又想：“大约他现在真要移向妹妹了，不好意思瞒我，所以要和我一谈。

en.t: But then she thought, "Most likely he truly means to turn toward my younger sister now, and because he feels bad about hiding it from me, he wants to speak with me.

units.source_text: 这又何妨，我和他并非以前不曾见过面，不要过分冷酷，让他在夜色未深之时早早到妹妹那里去吧。”

en.t: What harm is there in that? It is not as though he and I have never met before. I should not be too cold; I will let him go early to my sister before the night grows late."

units.source_text: 便略开纸门，露出头面。

en.t: So she opened the paper door slightly and showed her face.

units.source_text: 岂料薰君伸手到门缝中，抓住她的衣袖，把她拉过来，痛切地向她诉恨。

en.t: But unexpectedly, Lord Kaoru reached his hand through the crack of the door, seized her sleeve, pulled her toward him, and poured out his bitter reproaches to her.

units.source_text: 大女公子想：“真讨厌啊，太不成样子了！

en.t: Oigimi thought, "How hateful this is, and how terribly improper!

units.source_text: 我怎么会答应他会面的！”

en.t: How could I ever have agreed to meet him!"

units.source_text: 她后悔之极，痛苦不堪。

en.t: She was filled with extreme regret and suffered unbearably.

units.source_text: 然而还是耐性敷衍他，希望他早早离去，要求他同对她一样地对待妹妹。

en.t: Even so, she patiently humored him, hoping he would leave soon, and asked him to treat her younger sister in the same way he had treated her.

units.source_text: 这一片好心实甚可怜。

en.t: This single-minded kindness of hers was truly pitiable.
